description: This is a source file for a class named SyncWorker, which extends Worker and manages background synchronization tasks within an Android application. It schedules periodic sync jobs, handles execution flow, and manages callbacks and constraints related to network connectivity.

classes.name: SyncWorker
classes.description: Represents a background worker that performs synchronization tasks for notes, scheduled periodically or on-demand, respecting network constraints.

methods.name: SyncWorker
methods.description: Constructor initializing the worker with context and parameters.

methods.name: doWork
methods.description: Executes the synchronization process, waits for all account sync callbacks to complete, and returns success or failure result.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Schedules or cancels periodic synchronization work based on the backgroundSync toggle.

methods.name: deregister
methods.description: Cancels any existing scheduled sync work with the specified tag.
